gizmo.title: Masilaidi a ulaliki
gizmo.description: Onetsani ulaliki wa PowerPoint wotumizidwa silaidi ndi silaidi, pamodzi ndi zolemba za wolankhula.

configure.title: Mndandanda wa ulaliki
configure.description: Ikani fayilo ya .pptx ndipo idzasinthidwa yokha kukhala masilaidi. Gawo ili limaikidwa ku njira ya deck.json yopangidwa.

configure.title: Chizindikiro cha ulaliki
configure.description: Chimafunika pokhapokha tsamba lili ndi ulaliki woposa umodzi, kuti maulalo a masilaidi asafanane

advanced.title: Lolani kutsitsa
advanced.description: Onetsani batani lotsitsira fayilo yoyambirira ya PowerPoint pa zowongolera za chosewerera
